sloka: सहैभिरजिता लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वर ।हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः ।। ६.१२५.५ ।।
transliteration: sahaibhirajitā laṅkā nirjitā rākṣaseśvara ।hṛṣṭaiḥ prāṇabhayaṁ tyaktvā saṅgrāmeṣvanivartibhiḥ ।। 6.125.5 ।।

translations.english: "This Lanka could be won with the help of these heroes who never turned back and fought in comb at without fear of life, O Lord of Rakshasas."
